transcript: G'day mate, this is Marcus Vance calling. We're at 84 Glenferrie Road in Malvern. I'm after a quote to build a new 35-square-metre merbau timber deck and covered pergola in our backyard. Needs structural timber framing with treated pine joists and bearers, plus timber handrails along the steps. Need it framed up before the painters arrive next Tuesday. Give me a call back on 0418 332 901.

Hi there, Dave here from 42 Banksia Crescent over in Ringwood North. We're doing a big home extension and need a carpenter for timber stud wall framing, hanging 6 solid-core internal doors, and fitting architectural skirting boards throughout the ground floor. Looking to get this booked in in two weeks.

Hey guys, need a qualified carpenter at 19 Somerset St, Richmond. Need custom built-in timber cabinetry and shelving installed in the living room alcoves, plus replacing damaged window sills and timber architraves. Access is straight off the back lane so easy in and out.

Hello, this is Brenda Hughes at 14 Carrington Avenue, Mosman. We need an electrician to replace our old main switchboard. It has the original porcelain re-wireable fuses and no safety switches, and we keep losing power in the kitchen whenever the oven and kettle run at once. We also want to wire up an outdoor sub-board and weather-rated power points for a new pool pump out back. Looking to book someone in within the next 2 to 3 weeks.

Good morning. My name is Liam Patel, address is 205 Brunswick Street, Fitzroy. We've just taken delivery of a Tesla and need a 3-phase 11kW wall connector installed in the garage. The main switchboard is in the front hallway about 15 meters away, so cable will need to be run through the roof cavity. Ready to go immediately.

Emergency job if possible: 73 Kooyong Road, Caulfield North. Half our house has lost power, the safety switch tripped and won't reset even with all appliances unplugged. Smelled a bit of burning plastic near the hallway meter box.
G'day, looking for a quote to dig a 20-meter ditch for an electrical conduit from my shed to the granny flat in the back garden. Can you give me an estimate per metre?
Hi, I have a burst copper water pipe spraying water under our bathroom subfloor at 12 Elm Grove, Kew. Need a plumber urgently to shut it off and re-pipe the line.

Oh hi, uh yeah... look, my brother-in-law said you blokes do earthworks. We're over in Box Hill South, number 5 Wembley Avenue. Basically we bought this spa and the delivery guys said they won't put it down unless the ground is completely leveled out with a compacted crushed rock pad. It's about 3 by 3 metres in the corner of the lawn. Call me back on 0400 123 456.

Hi, we are at 88 Marine Parade, Elwood. We have solar panels on the roof and want to add a 10kWh home battery storage system and replace our switchboard enclosure with a smart meter. Let me know when you can come out for an inspection.
